style.backgroundSystem: flat seamless paper only: pure white #FFFFFF for packshots and grids, pale mist grey #E6E8E7 for the single-product and flat-lay frames, soft ivory #F5F1EC for texture and macro frames; deep navy #2B3A55 reserved for label plates and bands
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line marks and empty unbranded circular seal outlines left as reserved proof placeholders
style.lightingSystem: bright neutral 5500K studio light, large soft front-left key with a low-contrast fill, controlled wet specular on the lip surface, soft contact shadow under every upright product, no hard falloff
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clean glossy lip colour ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless white #FFFFFF, soft ivory #F5F1EC, pale mist grey #E6E8E7 and deep navy #2B3A55 for label plates, with one product-matched accent; bright neutral 5500K studio lighting, large soft front-left key with a low-contrast fill, controlled wet specular and soft contact shadows; flat seamless paper backgrounds only, no environmental sets; modern geometric sans-serif with one headline and one small label maximum, every wording slot carried by a placeholder; thin single-weight line marks and empty unbranded seal outlines; product upright at a stable scale, all lip frames cropped from the tip of the nose to below the chin with no eyes and no identifiable person; identical framing and light across grid tiles; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no platform or certification badges.
noDrift: no inconsistent lighting between grid tiles
no platform, marketplace or certification badges
style.presentationRules: the product stands upright at a stable scale; every lip frame is cropped from the tip of the nose to below the chin with no eyes and no identifiable person; comparison and variant grids keep identical framing, camera height and light in every tile
style.surfaceSystem: matte seamless paper sweep in #FFFFFF / #E6E8E7, plus one sheet of pale glossy acrylic #F5F1EC used only to carry formula smears
style.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif; one short headline plus at most one small label line per frame; every wording slot is a placeholder, never source wording
